question: What clauses govern late delivery credits?

Vendor supply agreements including CON-P2-0131 contain an Article 4 Late Delivery Credit penalty clause applying 1 percent of the delayed line value per verified week with a 5 percent cap.

Agreement CON-P2-0179 features a Late Delivery Credit penalty clause charging 1 percent per verified week of the delayed line value up to a 5 percent cap.

Structured ERP results show that contracts such as CON-P2-0001 include a Delay Service Credit clause applying a service credit of INR 25000 for each verified day beyond the SLA.
